lyrics:
[Intro: slow electric guitar, warm bass, finger snaps]

[Verse 1: smooth male baritone, close]
Preacher talked about the streets of gold
Mansions and a river, never growing old
I was looking down the pew at you
Thinking, well, that's a lot to live up to

[Chorus: silky harmonies, slow groove]
There better be a porch swing
And you in my old shirt
A little bit of rain coming, smell of the dirt
If it ain't got your feet up in my lap
I don't know what they're selling in that
Gold's fine, wings are fine, harps and everything
But there better be a porch swing

[Verse 2: baritone, organ underneath]
I ain't saying I know better than the Book
I'm just saying somebody ought to take a look
At a Tuesday evening, quarter to nine
'Cause I've seen paradise, and it's been mine

[Chorus: silky harmonies, slow groove]
There better be a porch swing
And you in my old shirt
A little bit of rain coming, smell of the dirt
If it ain't got your feet up in my lap
I don't know what they're selling in that
Gold's fine, wings are fine, harps and everything
But there better be a porch swing

[Bridge: guitar and voice]
And if I get there first, I'll hang it myself
Two chains, one board
And nobody else

[Final Chorus: fullest, a high harmony on top]
There better be a porch swing
And you in my old shirt
A little bit of rain coming, smell of the dirt
If it ain't got your feet up in my lap
I don't know what they're selling in that
Gold's fine, wings are fine, harps and everything
But there better be a porch swing

[Outro: a swing chain creaking, crickets, guitar]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 78 BPM, 4/4, G major. A slow jam: deep, smooth and close.

VOICE: Male baritone, low, velvety and relaxed, with a slight country drawl. He sings softly and a little behind the beat. Stacked harmonies in the choruses, with one high voice on top at the end.

INSTRUMENTS: A clean electric guitar playing slow, sliding phrases, round bass, finger snaps and a soft kick, electric piano, a quiet church organ, a little pedal steel, crickets and a creaking chain at the end.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar and snaps. 0:12 Verse 1. 0:40 Chorus 1. 1:12 Verse 2. 1:40 Chorus 2. 2:12 Bridge, guitar and voice. 2:28 Final chorus. 3:00 Outro, the swing and crickets, ends 3:18.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2017 country with R&B warmth: soft-edged, bass-rich and intimate.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'Two chains, one board, and nobody else' at 2:18.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original says nothing could be better than tonight. This is an older man in church who has had thirty years of such nights and has a clear idea what eternity should contain.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Amused, sure, devoted, promising.
